items.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
items.desc: COP31 气候峰会因化石燃料措辞和资金承诺谈崩，谈判无果而终。

vocab.en: a disagreement between people or groups
vocab.ex: Deep divisions over fossil fuels emerged at the COP31 talks.
vocab.exZh: COP31 谈判中出现了围绕化石燃料的严重分歧。

vocab.en: to deal with a difficult problem
vocab.ex: Countries failed to reach a deal to tackle climate change.
vocab.exZh: 各国未能就应对气候变化达成协议。

vocab.en: a promise to do something
vocab.ex: Poorer countries objected to the absence of clear financial commitments.
vocab.exZh: 较贫穷的国家反对协议中缺少明确的资金承诺。

vocab.en: a situation in which no progress can be made because the people involved cannot agree
vocab.ex: The new draft deal was presented to try to break the deadlock.
vocab.exZh: 新的协议草案被提出，试图打破僵局。

vocab.en: a strong desire to achieve something; the level of effort aimed for
vocab.ex: The EU said the decisions go nowhere near the level of ambition needed.
vocab.exZh: 欧盟表示，这些决定远远达不到应对气候变化所需的雄心水平。

vocab.en: relating to fuels such as coal, oil and gas formed from ancient plants and animals
vocab.ex: The final deal failed to directly mention fossil fuels.
vocab.exZh: 最终协议没有直接提及化石燃料。

en: Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey.
Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history.
But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
zh: 各国在土耳其举行的联合国 COP31 气候峰会上，因化石燃料和资金问题分歧严重，未能就应对气候变化达成新的重大协议。
谈判原定周五结束，却一直拖到周日仍在寻找共识，成为历时最长的联合国气候大会。
但最终协议令欧盟、太平洋岛国等国家无法接受，因为它没有直接提及化石燃料——全球变暖的主要原因。

en: Meanwhile, many poorer countries objected to the absence of any clear financial commitments from richer nations to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.
The last time a COP's main political agreement collapsed like this was in 2009 in Copenhagen.
UN secretary general Antonio Guterres, in his last COP before he steps down, said he was "deeply disappointed".
zh: 与此同时，许多较贫穷的国家反对协议中缺少富裕国家明确的资金承诺，而这些资金本应用于帮助它们适应气温上升带来的影响。
上一次 COP 主要政治协议如此崩盘还是在 2009 年的哥本哈根。
联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在他任内最后一次 COP 上表示，他“深感失望”。

en: After two weeks of negotiations, exhausted delegates were presented with a new, draft deal in the early hours of Sunday morning to try to break the deadlock.
But the words "fossil fuels" did not appear anywhere in the text.
The only indirect reference to coal, oil and gas was a nod to a deal agreed at COP28 in 2023, when countries agreed to "transition away" from fossil fuels in energy systems.
zh: 经过两周谈判，筋疲力尽的代表们在周日凌晨收到一份新的协议草案，试图打破僵局。
但“化石燃料”这几个字在文本中一次也没有出现。
文中对煤炭、石油和天然气唯一的间接提及，是呼应 2023 年 COP28 达成的协议——当时各国同意在能源系统中“逐步摆脱”化石燃料。

phrases.en: to not succeed in doing something
phrases.ex: He failed to pass the exam.
phrases.exZh: 他考试没通过。

phrases.en: looking for; seeking
phrases.ex: Negotiations ran late into Sunday in search of common ground.
phrases.exZh: 谈判一直拖到周日，仍在寻求共识。

phrases.en: to resign from an important job or position
phrases.ex: He will step down as secretary general next year.
phrases.exZh: 他将于明年卸任秘书长。

phrases.zh: 设法做某事；努力做某事
phrases.en: to attempt to do something
phrases.ex: Try to arrive on time.
phrases.exZh: 尽量准时到。

phrases.en: to say yes to doing something
phrases.ex: He agreed to help us.
phrases.exZh: 他同意帮助我们。

items.title: Two groups verify mathematician’s claim that Claude helped prove mathematics problem
items.desc: AI 软件 Claude 协助证明黎曼猜想，两家机构独立验证通过。

vocab.en: to solve a difficult problem
vocab.ex: The AI software helped crack one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics.
vocab.exZh: 这款 AI 软件帮助破解了数学中最重要的未解难题之一。

vocab.en: to check that something is true or correct
vocab.ex: Two organizations announced that they had independently verified the claim.
vocab.exZh: 两个机构宣布，他们已独立验证了这一说法。

vocab.en: an important discovery or development
vocab.ex: The proof marks another breakthrough in the use of AI for complicated math problems.
vocab.exZh: 这一证明标志着 AI 在解决复杂数学问题上的又一次突破。

vocab.en: a feeling of worry or discomfort
vocab.ex: Mathematicians express uneasiness around private companies paying millions to solve problems.
vocab.exZh: 数学家们对私营公司花数百万美元解题感到不安。

vocab.en: producing a lot of money
vocab.ex: Mathematicians worry about extremely lucrative private companies using AI to solve problems.
vocab.exZh: 数学家们担心极其赚钱的私营公司用 AI 来解题。

vocab.en: an idea that is suggested as a possible explanation, to be tested
vocab.ex: The Riemann hypothesis is a nearly 170-year-old math problem.
vocab.exZh: 黎曼猜想是一个近 170 年历史的数学难题。

en: A mathematician at Anthropic has said that the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) company’s software has helped crack one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics – and experts say the claim checks out.
Levent Alpöge, a Turkish American mathematician, on Friday posted a note on his personal website saying that Claude, the AI software, had helped prove the Riemann hypothesis.
He says that Claude helped develop a solution to the problem during the course of about six weeks.
zh: Anthropic 公司的一位数学家表示，这家位于旧金山的 AI 公司的软件帮助破解了数学中最重要的未解难题之一——专家称，这一说法经得起检验。
土耳其裔美国数学家莱文特·阿尔珀格周五在个人网站上发文称，AI 软件 Claude 帮助证明了黎曼猜想。
他说，Claude 在大约六周的时间里帮助找到了这个问题的解法。

en: On Saturday afternoon, two organizations announced that they had independently verified Alpöge’s claim after reviewing the programming language he used to share the solution.

The proof evidently marks another breakthrough in the use of AI for complicated math problems – even as mathematicians express uneasiness around extremely lucrative private companies dishing out millions of dollars for the technology to solve problems.
Alpöge linked to computer code – written in a language called Lean – that he maintained could verify the findings.
zh: 周六下午，两个机构宣布，在审阅了阿尔珀格分享解法时使用的编程语言后，他们已独立验证了他的说法。
这一证明显然标志着 AI 在解决复杂数学问题上的又一次突破——尽管数学家们对极其赚钱的私营公司花数百万美元用这项技术解题感到不安。
阿尔珀格附上了计算机代码链接——用一种叫作 Lean 的语言编写——他坚称这些代码可以验证他的发现。

en: The Riemann hypothesis is a nearly 170-year-old math problem named after Bernhard Riemann, a German mathematician who proposed it in 1859.
The hypothesis deals with prime numbers – whole numbers greater than 1 that can only be divided by themselves and 1.
The Riemann hypothesis is one of the seven Millennium prize math problems selected in 2000 by the Clay Mathematics Institute.
zh: 黎曼猜想是一个近 170 年历史的数学难题，以 1859 年提出它的德国数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼命名。
这一猜想涉及质数——大于 1、只能被自身和 1 整除的整数。
黎曼猜想是克雷数学研究所于 2000 年选出的七大千禧年数学难题之一。

phrases.en: To prove to be true; to be confirmed as correct.
phrases.ex: Experts say the claim checks out.
phrases.exZh: 专家表示这一说法经得起检验。

phrases.en: to do something regularly in the past, but not now
phrases.ex: I used to play football when I was young.
phrases.exZh: 我小时候常踢足球。

phrases.en: to give something out freely, often in large amounts
phrases.ex: The company is dishing out millions of dollars to solve the problem.
phrases.exZh: 这家公司正大把花钱来解决问题。

phrases.en: To address or discuss something as a subject; to be about something.
phrases.ex: The hypothesis deals with prime numbers.
phrases.exZh: 这一猜想涉及质数。

items.title: South Korean minister quits after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams
items.desc: 韩国大学入学考试爆出 AI 作弊丑闻，教育部长引咎辞职。

vocab.en: to leave a job or position officially
vocab.ex: South Korea’s education minister has resigned after the cheating scandal.
vocab.exZh: 韩国教育部长在作弊丑闻后辞职。

vocab.en: an event that shocks people because it involves wrong behaviour
vocab.ex: The minister quit after an AI-assisted cheating scandal.
vocab.exZh: 这位部长在一场 AI 辅助作弊丑闻后辞职。

vocab.en: to admit that you have done something wrong
vocab.ex: The top scorer confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone.
vocab.exZh: 这名状元承认自己使用了微型摄像头和智能手机。

vocab.en: strong action taken to stop something bad
vocab.ex: The unprecedented crackdown included doubling the number of supervisors.
vocab.exZh: 这次前所未有的严打包括把监考员人数翻倍。

vocab.en: intended to stop something bad from happening
vocab.ex: Officials rolled out a slew of preventive measures for the exams.
vocab.exZh: 官员们为考试推出了一系列预防措施。

vocab.en: behaviour that is wrong or against the rules
vocab.ex: Officials said 111 cases of misconduct were identified during the exam.
vocab.exZh: 官员们表示，考试期间查出了 111 起违规行为。

en: South Korea’s education minister has resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to key university entrance exams last week.

The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since last Sunday, when the top scorer in a national tax accountancy exam confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone to achieve a near-perfect score, just four days before the crucial university entrance exam, known as the suneung.
The cheat’s confession sent officials scrambling to roll out a slew of preventive measures for the university entrance exams, including blocking public wifi in testing areas.
zh: 韩国教育部长在一场 AI 辅助作弊丑闻爆发后辞职，这场丑闻发生在上周关键大学入学考试前夕。
自上周日以来，韩国一直笼罩在 AI 辅助考试作弊的恐惧中——当时一名全国税务师考试的状元承认，他用微型摄像头和智能手机考出了接近满分的成绩，而此时距离至关重要的大学入学考试（即“修能”考试）仅剩四天。
这名作弊者的供认让官员们匆忙推出一系列预防措施，包括在考场区域屏蔽公共 Wi-Fi。

en: The unprecedented crackdown included doubling the number of supervisors and sending emergency alerts to detect any smartphones illegally smuggled into the exam centres.
Students were also told to turn up with pencils only.
Erasers were provided by the test centres, as authorities tried to reduce the chances of concealed digital devices disguised as stationery.
zh: 这次前所未有的严打包括把监考员人数翻倍，并发送紧急警报，以查出被非法带进考场的智能手机。
学生们还被告知只能带铅笔进场。
考场提供橡皮，因为当局想减少伪装成文具的隐藏电子设备被带入的机会。

en: The government promised a reward of at least $75,000 (£57,300) for anyone reporting cheating or misconduct, with reduced penalties for those who turned in their accomplices.
But the education minister, Choi Kyo-jin, struggled to reassure the public, and teachers’ unions criticised the government response as belated.
The president, Lee Jae Myung, accepted his resignation, the presidential office said.
zh: 政府承诺，对举报作弊或违规行为者至少奖励 7.5 万美元，对交出同伙者减轻处罚。
但教育部长崔教振难以安抚公众，教师工会批评政府的应对姗姗来迟。
总统府表示，总统李在明已接受他的辞呈。

phrases.en: to introduce or launch something new
phrases.ex: Officials scrambled to roll out a slew of preventive measures.
phrases.exZh: 官员们匆忙推出了一系列预防措施。

phrases.en: to arrive or appear, especially unexpectedly
phrases.ex: Students were told to turn up with pencils only.
phrases.exZh: 学生们被告知只能带铅笔进场。

phrases.zh: 设法做某事；努力做某事
phrases.en: to attempt to do something
phrases.ex: Try to arrive on time.
phrases.exZh: 尽量准时到。

phrases.en: to give something or someone to the authorities; to hand in
phrases.ex: Those who turned in their accomplices would get reduced penalties.
phrases.exZh: 交出同伙的人将获得减刑。

items.title: Briton swims length of strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental cost of war
items.desc: 英国游泳者横渡霍尔木兹海峡，呼吁关注战争对海洋环境的破坏。

vocab.en: the ability to keep doing something difficult for a long time
vocab.ex: A British endurance swimmer has completed a three-day swim through the strait.
vocab.exZh: 一名英国耐力游泳运动员完成了为期三天的横渡海峡。

vocab.en: to draw attention to something
vocab.ex: He swam the strait to highlight the environmental cost of the war.
vocab.exZh: 他游过海峡，是为了凸显战争带来的环境代价。

vocab.en: to see something happen
vocab.ex: He witnessed several attacks on commercial shipping during the swim.
vocab.exZh: 他在游泳期间目睹了针对商船的多次袭击。

vocab.en: an object that is thrown or fired, such as a bullet or shell
vocab.ex: An oil tanker was struck by a projectile about 2.5 miles from where he was swimming.
vocab.exZh: 一艘油轮在他游泳地点约 2.5 英里外被一枚炮弹击中。

vocab.en: extremely large
vocab.ex: Pugh said war causes immense human suffering.
vocab.exZh: 皮尤说，战争造成了巨大的人员伤亡。

vocab.en: the process of making something dirty or harmful by adding a substance
vocab.ex: Oil spills and other contamination could harm marine ecosystems.
vocab.exZh: 石油泄漏和其他污染可能危害海洋生态系统。

en: A British endurance swimmer has completed a three-day swim through the strait of Hormuz to highlight the environmental cost of the Iran war.
Lewis Pugh, a UN patron of the oceans, swam the 9.3-mile (15km) length of the waterway, which is a key route for oil shipments from the Middle East.
According to the Lewis Pugh Foundation, he witnessed several attacks on commercial shipping, explosions in the distance and fighter jets overhead.
zh: 一名英国耐力游泳运动员完成了为期三天的横渡霍尔木兹海峡，以凸显伊朗战争带来的环境代价。
联合国海洋守护者刘易斯·皮尤游完了这条 9.3 英里（15 公里）长的水道，它是中东石油运输的关键通道。
据刘易斯·皮尤基金会称，他目睹了针对商船的多次袭击、远处的爆炸和头顶飞过的战斗机。

en: An oil tanker was struck by a projectile about 2.5 miles from where he was swimming on the first day.
On the second, he saw flames rising above a headland separating him from a burning liquefied petroleum gas carrier, Tara Gas, and later he passed close to the vessel while it was still on fire.
The 56-year-old undertook his first swim in a conflict zone to urge an end to the fighting, the reopening of the strait and action to address environmental damage caused by the conflict.
zh: 第一天，一艘油轮在他游泳地点约 2.5 英里外被一枚炮弹击中。
第二天，他看到火焰从一处海角上升起，海角另一边是一艘正在燃烧的液化石油气运输船“塔拉天然气号”，后来他在船只仍在燃烧时从附近游过。
这位 56 岁的游泳者首次在冲突地区游泳，呼吁结束战斗、重新开放海峡，并采取行动应对冲突造成的环境破坏。

en: Pugh said environmental damage caused by conflict often received less attention than the human cost.
According to the UN, at least 175 vessels have been attacked since fighting began, and about 30 attacks have caused significant pollution.
Pugh, who was born in Plymouth, said oil spills and other contamination could have long-term consequences for marine ecosystems including coral reefs, seagrass meadows and mangrove forests.
zh: 皮尤表示，冲突造成的环境破坏往往比人员伤亡受到的关注更少。
据联合国称，自战斗开始以来，至少有 175 艘船只遭到袭击，其中约 30 起袭击造成了严重污染。
出生于普利茅斯的皮尤说，石油泄漏和其他污染可能对包括珊瑚礁、海草床和红树林在内的海洋生态系统造成长期影响。

phrases.en: far away; a long distance away
phrases.ex: They heard explosions in the distance.
phrases.exZh: 他们听到远处传来爆炸声。

items.title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters
items.desc: AI“换皮”视频克隆真人创作者的表演，引发原创者愤怒。

vocab.en: changing something in a dishonest way to gain an advantage
vocab.ex: There is a new trend when it comes to digital manipulation.
vocab.exZh: 在数字造假方面出现了一种新趋势。

vocab.en: to make an exact copy of something
vocab.ex: Content creators are finding their performances cloned by AI characters.
vocab.exZh: 内容创作者发现自己的表演被 AI 角色克隆了。

vocab.en: looking or seeming like real life
vocab.ex: The AI characters are designed to look funny, realistic, or hypersexualised.
vocab.exZh: 这些 AI 角色被设计得滑稽、逼真，或过度性感。

vocab.en: in the end, after a long time
vocab.ex: The accounts use the videos to get views and likes, and to eventually make money.
vocab.exZh: 这些账号利用视频获取观看量和点赞，最终赚钱。

vocab.en: to make someone feel very annoyed
vocab.ex: The practice has angered content creators who say their work is being stolen.
vocab.exZh: 这种做法激怒了内容创作者，他们说自己的作品正在被偷走。

vocab.en: made or created first, not a copy
vocab.ex: Sometimes the AI version has millions more views than the original.
vocab.exZh: 有时 AI 版本的观看量比原版还要多出数百万。

en: But there is a new trend when it comes to digital manipulation.
Across social media, AI-generated characters are appearing in videos that look remarkably similar to those posted by real people.
From musicians to dancers and comedians, content creators are finding their performances cloned by these characters that are designed to look funny, realistic, or hypersexualised.
zh: 但在数字造假方面出现了一种新趋势。
在社交媒体上，AI 生成的角色出现在视频中，看起来与真人发布的视频非常相似。
从音乐家、舞者到喜剧演员，内容创作者发现自己的表演被这些角色克隆了，而这些角色被设计得滑稽、逼真，或过度性感。

en: Experts call the practice "reskinning" and say it is made possible by cheap, easy-to-use AI tools.
People can discover their work has been copied by seeing a video of a character making the same joke or doing the same dance, even with the same background.
Sometimes the AI version has millions more views than the original.
zh: 专家称这种做法为“换皮”，并表示这是廉价易用的 AI 工具让它成为可能。
人们发现自己的作品被抄袭，是因为看到某个角色讲着同样的笑话、跳着同样的舞，甚至背景都一模一样。
有时 AI 版本的观看量比原版还要多出数百万。

en: Some of the accounts identified by BBC Verify appear to be using these AI-generated videos to get views and likes, and to eventually make money.
Others appear to be experimenting with AI to make people laugh or simply for the attention that comes with going viral.
But the practice has angered content creators who say their original work is being stolen.
zh: BBC 核查团队发现的一些账号似乎在利用这些 AI 生成的视频来获取观看量和点赞，最终赚钱。
另一些账号似乎只是在试验 AI，想让人发笑，或者单纯为了走红带来的关注。
但这种做法激怒了内容创作者，他们说自己的原创作品正在被偷走。

phrases.en: to do something repeatedly to improve
phrases.ex: Practice speaking English every day.
phrases.exZh: 每天练习说英语。

items.title: NHS savings drive leaves hospitals in England facing ‘unpalatable’ cuts
items.desc: 英格兰数十家医院资金告急，被迫大幅削减服务与人手。

vocab.zh: 难以接受的；令人不快的
vocab.en: unpleasant and difficult to accept
vocab.ex: Hospitals are being forced to make ‘unpalatable’ cuts to services and staff.
vocab.exZh: 医院被迫对服务和人员做出“难以接受”的削减。

vocab.en: very clear and obvious, often in an unpleasant way
vocab.ex: Thirty-one trusts have issued stark warnings about budget savings.
vocab.exZh: 31 家信托机构已就预算削减发出严厉警告。

vocab.en: extremely serious or bad
vocab.ex: Twenty-seven trusts are in such dire financial straits.
vocab.exZh: 27 家信托机构的财务状况如此糟糕。

vocab.en: in a dangerous state and likely to get worse
vocab.ex: Trust bosses say their finances are in a ‘precarious’ and ‘severe’ state.
vocab.exZh: 信托机构负责人表示，他们的财务状况处于“岌岌可危”和“严重”的状态。

vocab.en: to become smaller
vocab.ex: Trusts are shrinking their workforces to save money.
vocab.exZh: 信托机构正在缩减员工队伍以节省开支。

vocab.en: the situation of not having enough workers
vocab.ex: Understaffing is widespread across the NHS.
vocab.exZh: 人手不足的现象在 NHS 普遍存在。

en: Dozens of hospitals are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients and are being forced to make “unpalatable” cuts to services and staff, the Guardian can reveal.
Thirty-one health service trusts in England have issued stark warnings that NHS demands for them to make huge budget savings this year threaten their ability to function normally.
All have declared that as a threat in the register of risks they have to maintain and publish.
zh: 数十家医院资金极度短缺，可能无法继续照护病人，被迫对服务和人员做出“难以接受”的削减，《卫报》独家披露。
英格兰 31 家医疗服务信托机构已发出严厉警告：NHS 要求它们今年大幅削减预算，威胁到它们正常运转的能力。
它们都已把这一问题列入必须维护和公布的风险登记册。

en: Twenty-seven of those trusts are in such dire financial straits that they have rated lack of money as the biggest threat they face.
Six have given that danger a rating of 25 – the highest possible score – in their risk register.

A much-larger number of trusts have launched cost-cutting programmes to save as much as £106m each this year by limiting the services they provide and shrinking their workforces, despite understaffing being widespread across the NHS.
zh: 其中 27 家信托机构的财务状况如此糟糕，以至于把缺钱列为面临的最大威胁。
其中 6 家给这一风险打了 25 分——风险登记册中的最高分。
更多的信托机构已启动削减成本计划，通过限制服务和缩减员工队伍，今年各自最多节省 1.06 亿英镑，尽管 NHS 人手不足的现象普遍存在。

en: Trust bosses say their finances are in a “precarious” and “severe” state.
They blame rising drug prices, strikes and the cost of covering pay rises, the extra demand caused by this summer’s heatwaves, and the introduction of electronic health records.

Privately they accuse NHS England of forcing them to adopt unreasonable savings targets in order to help the health service as a whole balance its books, because hospitals have been told to stop overspending.
zh: 信托机构负责人表示，他们的财务状况处于“岌岌可危”和“严重”的状态。
他们把原因归咎于药价上涨、罢工、支付加薪的成本、今年夏天热浪带来的额外需求，以及电子健康档案的引入。
他们私下指责 NHS 英格兰机构迫使它们采纳不合理的节约目标，以帮助整个医疗服务系统实现收支平衡，因为医院已被告知要停止超支。

phrases.en: not having enough of something; lacking
phrases.ex: Dozens of hospitals are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients.
phrases.exZh: 数十家医院资金极度短缺，可能无法继续照护病人。

phrases.en: Can, to have the ability to.
phrases.ex: I am able to swim.
phrases.exZh: 我会游泳。

phrases.en: must; to be obliged to do something
phrases.ex: I have to do my homework now.
phrases.exZh: 我现在必须做作业。

phrases.en: As a means of achieving something; to.
phrases.ex: In order to be fit, you've gotta train hard every day.
phrases.exZh: 为了保持健康，你必须每天刻苦训练。

phrases.en: to no longer do something
phrases.ex: Please stop talking.
phrases.exZh: 请不要再说话了。
